description: This file defines the main React application component 'App' which sets up routing for different pages of the dashboard interface. It imports React, routing components from react-router-dom, styling files, and various page components. The component provides a layout with a navigation bar, dynamic content based on routes, and a footer. It acts as the entry point for the frontend application, organizing navigation and rendering of pages.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main application component providing routing and layout.
